title: Titanium Air Sparger Pipe
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Air Sparger Pipe where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Perforated air agitation sparger pipe requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by perforated air agitation sparger pipe and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for tank hardware geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with 0.5mm corner radius
Pickling and passivation with 0.5mm corner radius
Continuity test <1 mOhm with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for perforated air agitation application
commonFailures: Uneven coating from current density variation - corrected by auxiliary anode 50mm from cathode — critical for perforated air agitation performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium Air Sparger Pipe resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium Air Sparger Pipe resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for perforated air agitation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Air Sparger Pipe orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Air Sparger Pipe is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Air Sparger Pipe?
faq.a: Each Titanium Air Sparger Pipe shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for perforated air agitation.
